name: cache-clock
description: Status line with today's AI window and quiet hours (from config/clock.json) and your 5-hour and weekly limits, plus how long until this chat's prompt cache goes cold; warns before a cold message re-reads the whole chat at full price, and /keepwarm pings it cheaply while you step away (up to 2 hours).

ttlMinutes.title: Cache lifetime (minutes)
ttlMinutes.description: 60 on a Claude subscription, 5 with an API key.
